title: Columbus ballrooms and dance halls
summary: He lists the ballrooms and halls of Columbus where a different band played each night.

story.theme_name: Dance halls, lake camps and riverboat bandstands
story.community_name: Dance halls, lake resorts and where bands played

blocks.x: And they have the capital there, see, the state penitentiary there, which we don't want to mention. But everything -- Columbus is pretty big, you know. And they had the Graystone Ballroom there, the had the Valley Dale Ballroom, they had another ballroom called Lane Askin's, they had another room called -- oh, there's a theater there on Long Street in the black neighborhood, the Pitian Temple, that was a dancehall, the Masonic Hall, that was a dancehall. And bands used to play around there, every night there was a different band playing.
They wouldn't be playing every night?
